text.en: Collecting an Orb of Power grants a period of maximum power that starts with an automatic reload. Sustained fire in this mode suppresses targets.
Collecting an Orb of Power grants a period of maximum power that starts with an automatic reload. Sustained fire in this mode suppresses targets.

Collecting an Orb of Power grants 'Supercharged Magazine' for 10 seconds and <title refills [G_refill] /> the magazine. Additional orbs grant 10 seconds each, extending the duration up to 20 seconds. Buff can be activated while stowed.

Supercharged Magazine sets the power level to High for the duration of the buff, and dealing sustained damage for 2 seconds applies <void/>Suppression for 7 seconds.

Collecting an Orb of Power grants 'Supercharged Battery' for 10 seconds and <title refills [G_refill] /> the magazine. Additional orbs grant 10 seconds each, extending the duration up to 20 seconds. Buff can be activated while stowed.

Supercharged Battery sets the power level to High for the duration of the buff, and dealing sustained damage for 2 seconds applies <void/>Suppression for 7 seconds.
